Owner(s).note: Open the We Energies air permit revision application at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1248468 and go to page 21. The sentence 'We Energies - Valley Station is owned by Wisconsin Electric Power Company (dba We Energies)' states the owner. This matches the value GEM already has.

Backup Power.note: Open the permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1170244. The boilers are listed as 900 MMBtu per hour natural gas boilers that run as normal plant equipment. Nothing in the equipment list marks them as backup units. This is implied by the equipment list, not stated.

Conversion/replacement?.note: Open the final Wisconsin air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1170244. The permit history table, row 13-RSG-067 dated 11/11/2013, reads 'Conversion of B21, B22, B23, B24 to NG'. That is the conversion of the boilers from coal to natural gas.

CCS attachment?.note: Open the Wisconsin air permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1170244. Its list of emission units for boilers B21 to B24 names only flue gas recirculation as the control device and no carbon capture equipment. No document says 'no carbon capture' in words, so this rests on the equipment list.

Start year.note: Open the permit at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1170244 and go to the emission unit list, page 20 of the application at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1248468. Boilers B21 and B22 read 'Natural Gas-Fired Boiler - Installed 1968, modified 2014'. So 2014 is the year the boiler was modified for gas, which is the conversion year GEM records. EIA lists 1968, the year the original coal unit began operating, in the file at https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx.

milestones.period_note: The permit gives only the year of modification, not a month.

qa.question: Is unit 1's conversion year 2014 or November 2015?
qa.finding: The air permit lists boilers B21 and B22 as 'modified 2014'. A 2025 We Energies application at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1248468 says on page 4 'the conversion of VAPP's primary fuel source from coal to natural gas in November 2015'.
qa.recommendation: Leave the start year at 2014 for unit 1 and 2015 for unit 2, since the permit gives those modification years per boiler.
qa.note: The permit history row 13-RSG-067 at https://apps.dnr.wi.gov/warp_ext/AM_DownloadObject.aspx?id=1170244 shows the gas conversion permit was issued in November 2013.
